name: Jot
description: Quick capture of a note or to-do without leaving the one you are in. A small form for the title, a line or two of text, the notebook, tags and the due date, opened by a shortcut, from highlighted text, or by typing ++ in the editor. The note is created where you say, and you stay where you were.
author: pmslava

screenshots.label: The form for a new to-do: title, text, notebook, tags and a due date, opened by the shortcut over the note you are in
The date picker unfolded under the Due row, with its calendar, time columns and quick buttons
Two highlighted lines become the title and text of a new to-do, with the choice of what happens to them in the note
Typing ++ in the Markdown editor opens the form, and the ++ becomes a link to the new note or is removed
Edit with Jot… changes an existing to-do's title, type, notebook, tags and due date without opening it
